review.notes: Sample: all 15 seeded targets checked against DLMF Release 1.2.8 (2026-09-15) equations 5.2.8-5.16.2 and the 5.1 notation (5.12.9 checked against its TeX); Titchmarsh 5.81, AAR Ch. 3/8 and Temme Ch. 3 not verifiable. Gate: tex=40 FAIL (R03), all other checks 0; depcheck with the candidate order 0 problems; no change outside the folder. Elaboration: 76 sorry warnings only; #check signatures compared; one-tactic probe closes hasSum_invGammaCoeff. Adversarial: all 76 headlines evaluated numerically (complex parameters, two contour radii) or analytically, all hold; one false Check (Temme phase, R05). Blocking: R01 (P1) the README cites Tau Ceti main declarations absent at the pin 2fd255d9, so 5.6.6 and 5.7.6 have no owner; R02 (P2) ExplicitNumberFields 1.1a owns 5.7.6/5.15.1 on Re z > 0 and is not cited.
